posts.description: Step into Materium, the ultimate interactive chemistry playground for young scientists, students, and curiosity seekers! Explore the universe of chemical elements through hands-on atomic sandbox experiments, interactive 2D Bohr models, and exciting chemistry challenges.

posts.name: PolicyWatcher
posts.tagline: AI-assisted, digital policy and AI governance tracker
posts.description: Like many of you, I was tired of receiving "We've updated our Terms of Service" emails with zero clue about what actually changed, whether my data would be used to train AI models, or how prompt retention policies were evolving. Reading 40 pages of legal jargon for every SaaS tool we use isn't scalable. That's why I built PolicyWatcher: an open civic-tech platform that monitors public policy changes across major tech and fintech companies in real time.

posts.name: Waivly
posts.tagline: Connect, learn, and grow with ambitious professionals
posts.description: Connect, learn, and grow in the private global network built for meaningful relationships, new opportunities, and lasting progress.

posts.name: wkearly
posts.tagline: The alarm that makes you actually get up
posts.description: wkearly is an Android alarm that won't stop ringing until you solve a math problem, do push-ups, or snap a photo of the sky. It also tracks how much you actually slept, you log bedtime the night before, so your streak rewards real rest, not just tapping dismiss on time.

posts.name: Live Accessibility Overlay
posts.tagline: Accessibility problems in plain English, not rule codes
posts.description: Accessibility tools usually hand you a wall of rule codes. Live Accessibility Overlay tells you what is wrong in plain English, shows you where it is on the page, and suggests a fix. Click the icon on any page for a short list of problems sorted by what to fix first: hard to read text, images with no description, keyboard focus that jumps backwards. For colour issues it suggests the closest readable colour, ready to copy. Everything runs locally. Nothing is uploaded, no accounts.

posts.name: AiScribe - Store your ai coding session
posts.tagline: No paywalls. No limit your sessions. Your data. Your machine
posts.description: AiScribe #How It Works 1. You code. AiScribe watches the git diff in the background. 2. Run aiscribe log. It sends your diff to an LLM and generates a summary. Use -c to capture the full AI conversation too. 3. Done. Markdown file saved inaiscribe/sessions/. #Pick Your LLM OpenRouter - 200+ models, one key. Anthropic - Claude Sonnet, Opus. OpenAI - GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini. DeepSeek - Cheap, fast. Ollama - Local. # Quick Start npm install -g aiscribe cd your-project aiscribe log -c

posts.name: YouTube to Transcript AI
posts.tagline: Turn any YouTube video into transcript and AI summaries.
posts.description: YouTube to Transcript AI turns long videos into searchable text in seconds. Paste a link or use our new Chrome extension to generate accurate transcripts, SRT/VTT subtitles, and AI summaries without ever leaving your browser. Stop scrubbing—start reading.

posts.name: GovGazette
posts.tagline: Federal contract research for humans and AI agents
posts.description: Search federal contract opportunities and public award history in a clear web app, through a hosted MCP server, or with a documented REST API. Public research needs no API key. OAuth adds saved searches and tracked pursuits without delete or billing access.

posts.name: AdmitPlus.AI
posts.tagline: A multimodal AI learning team, built around you.
posts.description: Most AI learning tools give students answers and move on. AdmitPlus gives every student a multimodal AI learning team that plans a personalized path, adapts to how they learn, and guides them through explanation, practice, and feedback toward mastery. It turns the one-to-many classroom model into a continuous one-to-one learning experience.

posts.name: PR Flow
posts.tagline: See which PRs need you, across all your platforms
posts.description: PR Flow is a desktop app that brings pull requests from GitHub, GitLab, Azure and Gerrit into one place. It shows what needs your attention, who each PR is waiting on, and which items are going stale. Instead of constantly checking tabs and notifications, you get a clear view of the review queue and can jump straight into the PR that needs action.

posts.name: The Bigger Picture
posts.tagline: Find 15 cleverly hidden clues in every picture
posts.description: A visual puzzle game packed with cleverly hidden clues inspired by Movies, Music and TV. Examine every detail, unravel the wordplay and challenge yourself, friends and family to uncover the bigger picture.

posts.name: Paitify
posts.tagline: The authorization layer for AI agent spending
posts.description: AI agents ask Paitify before they pay: instant approve/deny against your policies, human in the flow, and a tamper-evident audit trail of every decision. Rail-agnostic, MCP-native, works with Claude. Never moves your money.

posts.name: MeetingsAI: Notes & Summary
posts.tagline: The private AI notetaker with on-device AI, works offline
posts.description: Since our Feb 2026 launch we shipped: an Apple Watch app (record from your wrist), a Chrome extension for desktop meetings, Cheat Mode (live AI answers during interviews), quiz generation from any recording, big on-device AI upgrades (faster local models, offline improvements), and instant live translation windows. Transcribe & summarize anything: meetings, calls, voice notes, files, YouTube & X in 100+ languages, with live two-way translation. Private Mode runs AI 100% on-device.

posts.name: PulseSync v2.0
posts.tagline: Keep your everyday health data in one simple app.
posts.description: PulseSync is an all-in-one health tracker: steps, sleep, water, weight, workouts, nutrition, and mood/energy/stress — synced across your devices and with Apple Health & Health Connect. It doesn't just log your day; it finds the patterns between your habits, like "you sleep better on days you train." Includes an offline library of 873 exercises with demos, streaks, achievements, and a shareable weekly recap. Private by design, local-first. Rebuilt from scratch in 2.0.

posts.name: Calcxi - Water Intake Calculator
posts.tagline: Calculate your precise daily water needs
posts.description: Calculate exactly how much water you should drink per day based on your weight, activity, climate, diet, and caffeine intake. Includes a personalized hourly drinking schedule, urine color checker, food water tracker, and today's intake tracker. Free — based on NIH & ACSM guidelines.

posts.name: ossium
posts.tagline: The ultimate hub for open-source contributors.
posts.description: Search for OSS projects with unmatched speed and precision. Eliminate noise to find the best open-source solutions. Discover handpicked open-source repos, good first issues, and GSoC orgs. Contribute faster, today.

posts.name: Solheim AI - your Virtual Private LLM
posts.tagline: Private and Secure LLM for a fixed monthly fee
posts.description: A virtual private LLM: one project, one VPL, sized by how many requests run at once. Flat monthly fee, no usage window, no reset timer, EU-hosted.

posts.name: THRN
posts.tagline: Clarity For Your Next Marketing Move
posts.description: AI marketing consultant for strategy, audits, and growth plans. The senior marketer you actually need.

posts.name: Muvi
posts.tagline: Build, stream, and monetize video on every screen
posts.description: Muvi is a no-code, all-in-one streaming platform that lets you launch your own OTT service — like Netflix, Udemy, or Spotify — without writing a line of code. Stream live or on-demand video and audio, deploy native apps on 10+ platforms (iOS, Android, Apple TV, Roku, Samsung TV, and more), monetize with subscriptions or pay-per-view, and manage everything from one dashboard.

posts.name: Clipperia
posts.tagline: Save time creating clips, rough cuts & audio censorship
posts.description: Content repurposing toolkit for video editors and creators. Extract clips from long-form video, build rough cut timelines with EDL export for DaVinci Resolve, or auto-censor for broadcast-safe output. Your editorial workflow, faster.
